To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
our model is language independent, uses no domain specific feature or handcrafted rules and uses only semantic information in the from of word vectors.
we can achieve state-of-the-art performance on both English and Hindi NER tasks using only word embeddings and Bi-LSTM without any domain-specific feature engineering.
we have developed a language independent NER system which does not use any language specific features and is based on an unsupervised algorithm to learn semantic information.
In summary, our research is concerned with
building an end to end NER system that does not require any handcrafted linguistic knowledge or gazetteers.
developing deep learning based NER system for Hindi which is language independent, domain independent and does not require morphological analysis.
developing a deep learning based NER model for Hindi which is based on a language independent architecture and which is trained with only a few hundred of labelled examples.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we are able to achieve state of the art results in Hindi NER with no handcrafted features or rules and without using gazetteer.
our model outperforms all other models on both the datasets.
the proposed approach is a step towards deep learning in Hindi NER and it is the first attempt in this direction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

our models are able to learn the semantic and morphological features from the word vectors which are learned by an unsupervized learning algorithm and the syntactic information from the BiDirectional R-N-N-LSTM architecture.
our models are able to learn semantic information in the word embeddings and are able to generalize the same across languages.
our models are the first to achieve state of the art NER performance in both English as well as Hindi using no domain knowledge, no gazetteers, no morphological analysis, and no handcrafted rules.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the model is language independent.
a simple model with no domain knowledge can achieve state of the art accuracy.
the performance of a NER system can be greatly improved by using word vectors as a semantic feature and by using a deep learning model.
